prerequisites.reason: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors are defined through matrix operations.
Gradient descent uses gradients, which are built from partial derivatives.
Curvature analysis relies on first and second partial derivatives.
Multivariate curvature analysis uses Hessian matrices and related matrix operations.
Hessian eigenvalues are used to characterize local curvature.
Neural network training commonly depends on gradient-based optimization.
Backpropagation requires computing partial derivatives of the loss with respect to weights.
Neural network forward and backward computations are expressed using matrix operations.
